content: keep trying, come up with 10 unique experiments

scene: Create a recognizable front-facing owl at night. Two separate large bright eyes, a small pointed beak between and below them, pointed ear tufts, rounded body, two folded wings, and two feet. Dark empty margin around the owl. Choose the composition yourself. Coordinates start at top left; x grows right and y grows down.
note: All choices returned by Jev. Fixed display mappings are documented per request.
